title: A fresh sprint reviewer writes its gap list to a report file the orchestrator reads, not only to its session's last message
goal: the kb-sprint skill's review step starts the read-only reviewer with a brief that names a report file in its scratch directory, and the reviewer writes its final gap list there, so the orchestrator reads the report even when the session's last message is a short follow-up (claude -p's result holds only the last turn)

run:
import re,sys
t=open(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
i=t.index("## review SP");j=t.find("\n## ",i+5);s=t[i:j if j>0 else len(t)]
brief=bool(re.search(r"report file[^.]{0,200}scratch|scratch[^.]{0,200}report file",s))
writes=bool(re.search(r"gap list[^.]{0,200}report file|report file[^.]{0,200}gap list",s))
print("review step names a report file in the reviewer's scratch directory:",brief,"| the reviewer writes its gap list there:",writes)
sys.exit(0 if brief and writes else 1)

clauses.clause: the kb-sprint skill's review step starts the read-only reviewer with a brief that names a report file in its scratch directory
the reviewer writes its final gap list there, so the orchestrator reads the report even when the session's last message is a short follow-up (claude -p's result holds only the last turn)

notes: Premise: the check fails on the base: the review step names no report file in the reviewer's scratch directory and does not say the reviewer writes its gap list there.
